about: A desk tray holds five dated news clippings. The cover stacks five folded slips. Each item pins a real photo or source screenshot above its headline and benefit. A numbered tab marks each clipping. Source, date and picture credit sit below in mono type. The close files all five slips. A mint corner links every page.

cover.note: Five folded paper slips signal the five stories. Real news is filled later.

example.photo: The local story photo or source screenshot
example.headline: The verified news headline
example.source: The source publication and article name
example.credit: The picture owner or source screenshot credit

item.note: Repeat for exactly five verified stories of people helped by AI. Number each tab 1 to 5. Supply a real photo or source screenshot at render time, never in the kit. The 960 by 640 photo slot crops from the top. Source, date and picture credit are required.

close.note: The five clippings return to the desk tray.
